planner_finish.summary:
Solved libero_spatial task 5 seed 0 in ONE episode (no reset): "pick up the black bowl on the ramekin and place it on the plate" -> terminated:true.

Perception: verified the high-res image matches agentview_world_high.npz (cabinet probe z=1.028), then region back-projected every entity. Critically, the two black patterned bowls are identical, so I disambiguated by SUPPORT relation: my task language names the ramekin, so the target was the upper-right bowl elevated on the gray metal cup (agentview (-0.196,0.204,0.963), wrist-refined to (-0.202,0.204)), NOT the look-alike bowl on the red cookie box that the seed-0 sister audit (perturbed "cookie box" language) had targeted. Destination plate localized in RGB as the white/red-ring ceramic disc at (0.081,0.190) top z=0.910, explicitly not the gray stove burner.

Execution: hover 15 cm over the target, pi0_pick with the short prompt "pick up the black bowl" (12/14 chunks, lift 0.058 m), verified the grasp from the wrist cam + newly-empty ramekin, firmed with set_gripper +1. Measured the per-pick held offset (bowl = eef + (-0.013,-0.048), bottom 4.2 cm below eef), carried at eef z 1.09-1.10 in three capped-Delta waypoints holding gripper:+1, centred the bowl over the plate, and descended to eef z 0.955 so the bowl's bottom contacted the plate top. release fired top-level terminated:true in 2 steps on the first placement — no near-target re-pick was needed. Audit + recipe written.
